gates.criteria: Controlled reference, same boundary and interval; both directions ≤1%, zero traffic, >4GiB, resets/hotplug; numeric evaluator is not independence proof.
VPN off/on on authorized network, compare physical and virtual counters separately, prove no duplicate in aggregate; unknown on ambiguous overlap.
IPv4-only, IPv6-only, dual stack, TCP and UDP; distinguish absent family and parser failure, require independent path evidence.
Operator switches Wi-Fi/Ethernet or disconnects using macOS UI, verify scope revocation, stale-rate clear, monotonic totals and no unsolicited mutations.
Operator sleeps/wakes Mac, verify no invented bytes or stale forecast, explicit gap, no process controls.
Opt-in owned development task; compare independent process identity across exit/restart, verify protected workflow and no process termination.
Official current policy scope, byte unit, reset, identity, same interval and boundary; absence not safe, compare directions.
Independent trust-boundary and negative TLS, file alias/race and lifecycle review; fixture tests alone not closure.
BLOCKED: real mutation adapter disabled; only simulation until separately authorized transactional snapshot and rollback protocol reviewed.
Explicit existing process PID, verify exact binary SHA/provenance, idle conditions, repeated ≥300s samples, CPU <0.5% one core and RSS <80MB; separately inspect child processes.
Keyboard, VoiceOver, non-color states, light/dark, display scaling; UX-01–06/08; no unsafe prompts.
≥5 representative novice sessions; ≥80% unassisted completion of status/quota/pause/diagnosis and zero unsafe consent errors.
BLOCKED for upgrade/uninstall: isolated test install destination, verify no overwrite or data loss, rollback and uninstall; no real user install by runner.
Explicit process read-only monitoring for ≥168 hours with continuous evidence, no unexplained restart or gap; independently review crash/functional behavior.
BLOCKED: entitlement/signing and explicit owner authorization required; no extension activation by runner.
